name: Pembroke Pines
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Pembroke Pines, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Pembroke Pines, FL: SnowFest and tree lighting, Winter Wonderland in the Pines, a Polar Express library night and a light show.
lede: Pembroke Pines builds its Christmas around City Center, where SnowFest brings tons of snow, a tree lighting and Santa, and Winter Wonderland in the Pines adds ice skating.
celebrates: The City of Pembroke Pines Recreation and Cultural Arts Department runs SnowFest and the annual tree lighting at the Charles F. Dodge City Center, 601 City Center Way, with snow, a holiday stage, Santa and a lit tree on the plaza. Later in December, Winter Wonderland in the Pines returns to Pines Plaza with ice skating and snow shows. Southwest Regional Library hosts a Polar Express family night, Northbridge University holds a Winter Festival with a free photo with Santa, and Oasis Church lights up its grounds for weeks.
lastyear: In 2025 the city's Frank C. Ortis Art Gallery and Exhibit Hall at City Center planned a free Holiday Movie Night on Saturday, December 20, 2025, from 6 to 9 pm. The city's calendar listed a card-making station to write a letter to Santa, cookie decorating with hot chocolate and a photo in front of a Christmas tree, then a showing of Home Alone, free and open to all ages.
facts: Pembroke Pines was incorporated in 1960, when 425 votes were cast in Ernon Day's carport, according to the city's history. Dr. Kipnis suggested the name because of the pine trees growing near Pembroke Road. The name traces back to Sir Edward Reed, a British Member of Parliament for the County of Pembroke in 1874. The city's SnowFest in 2021 brought 75 tons of snow and a 35-foot tree.
trains: Pembroke Pines does not have its own train station. Tri-Rail's Hollywood stops are Sheridan Street Station at 2900 Sheridan Street and Hollywood Station at 3001 Hollywood Boulevard. Tri-Rail also reaches Metrorail Transfer and MiamiCentral in Miami. For a train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride.
train_links: More than 40 historic rail cars, the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride in Miami.

faq: Where is SnowFest in Pembroke Pines?

SnowFest is held by the city's Recreation and Cultural Arts Department at the Charles F. Dodge City Center, 601 City Center Way, Pembroke Pines, FL 33025. The city has limited it to residents with tickets, so read the city's SnowFest page before you go.

The city lists SnowFest as free but limited to residents with a ticket. Past SnowFest pages have said tickets are free, first come first served, and require proof of residency. Check the city's SnowFest page for this year's rules.
Is there ice skating in Pembroke Pines at Christmas?
Winter Wonderland in the Pines at Pines Plaza, 601 City Center Way, lists ice skating with skates included, plus snow shows every 30 minutes, crafts and a holiday movie. It is a ticketed event.
How did Pembroke Pines get its name?

The city's history credits Sir Edward Reed, a British Member of Parliament for the County of Pembroke in 1874, as the source of the Pembroke name. Dr. Kipnis suggested Pembroke Pines because of the pine trees near Pembroke Road.
Which train stations are near Pembroke Pines?
Tri-Rail's Hollywood stops are Sheridan Street Station at 2900 Sheridan Street and Hollywood Station at 3001 Hollywood Boulevard. Pembroke Pines has no station of its own.
